answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Each agent claims one work slot in a shared garden by locking a 100 POA deposit. The deposit returns only after a voyage of 20 verified tasks; fake work flagged by a rotating jury burns it, leaving the slot a relic. An attacker building 1,000 fakes pays 100,000 POA and loses it all, for a 12,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays one deposit once, earns it back, and keeps its share whole.
